DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

hands down the number 1 recipe I get tagged in with all of your beautiful remakes!! 🥰 it’s no surprise this one is so popular because it’s so so easy, made with simple ingredients, & tastes absolutely delicious!!  all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

videos.caption: 🍪 CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIE SHOTS 🤎 Cute little chocolate chip cookie shots, perfect for filling with cold milk. Makes 9 cookie shots. Ingredients: • 1½ cups (227 g) all-purpose flour • ⅓ cup (65 g) packed brown sugar • 2 tbsp + 2 tsp (33 g) granulated sugar • ½ tsp baking powder • Pinch of salt • 6 tbsp (88 g) butter • 1 large egg • 1 tsp vanilla paste • ½ cup + 1 tbsp (100 g) mini semi-sweet chocolate chips For the chocolate coating: • 120 g milk chocolate, melted Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Lightly grease the cookie shot mold and inserts. 2. Mix flour, sugars, baking powder, and salt. 3. Melt butter and let cool slightly. Whisk in egg and vanilla paste. 4. Combine wet and dry ingredients, then fold in chocolate chips. 5. Divide dough into 9 balls. Place into the mold and press inserts firmly down. 6. Bake for 17–19 minutes with inserts in place. 7. Trim the edges while warm. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then gently remove inserts and let cool completely. 8. Melt 120 g of milk chocolate and coat the inside of each cookie shot. Let the chocolate set completely, then fill with cold milk and enjoy🤎 #cookies #chocolatechipcookies #dessertrecipes #viralrecipes #christmasdesserts

Chicken Au Poivre‼️ Full Video Things you need  Whole chicken Sherry Wine (Holland House Cooking Wine) 1 Large Shallot Minced Garlic (3-4 cloves) Heavy Whipping Cream, 2 - 2.5 cups Fresh Cracked Black Pepper Fresh Rosemary, chopped    Chicken Seasoning: Salt, Cracked Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Chili Powder, Paprika, Kinder’s Buttery Poultry Seasoning, Dried Parlsey  Sauce Seasoning: Salt, Cracked Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder Directions  1. Prepare the Chicken Clean the chicken using 1 part vinegar to 2 parts water. Remove the insides, then butterfly the chicken by cutting out the backbone with kitchen shears. Lay the chicken meat‑side up, pat dry, and press down firmly to flatten. Season generously with the listed seasonings, including salt and cracked black pepper on the underside. 2. Cook the Chicken Preheat the oven to 375°F. Heat a large skillet over medium‑high. Once hot, sear the whole chicken skin‑side down until browned, about 4–5 minutes per side. If cooking multiple chickens, repeat the process. Transfer the browned chicken(s) to a baking dish. Add about 1/3 cup water to the bottom of the dish, cover, and place in the oven while you prepare the sauce 3. Prepare the Sauce In the same skillet used for searing, add diced shallots, garlic, and chopped rosemary. Cook for 3–4 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the chicken. Deglaze with 1/2 cup Sherry cooking wine and cook for 2–3 minutes. Add 2 – 2.5 cups heavy whipping cream, whisking to combine. Season with the listed sauce seasonings and cook for 3–4 minutes, whisking occasionally. 4. Finish the Dish Remove the chicken from the oven and pour the cream sauce over the top. Return to the oven and cook for 60–90 minutes, depending on the size of the chicken, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone. videos.caption: This Pepper Steak is a simple recipe that can made in under 1 hour for a weeknight dinner. Full recipe is posted below and on my blog (check bio) My cookbook, Let’s Get Into It, is currently on sale at its lowest price on Amazon!  Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. Pat steak dry. Thinly slice flank steak against the grain into about ¼-inch strips. Add steak into a medium-sized bowl. 2. For the steak marinade, toss the steak in soy sauce, minced garlic, oil, rice vinegar, cornstarch, black pepper, sugar, and baking soda. Mix well and fully coat the steak in the marinade. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, up to 1 hour. 3. To make the sauce, in a separate medium-sized bowl add in soy sauce, beef stock, rice vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, and black pepper. Mix and whisk together ingredients well. Set aside. 4. When ready to cook, heat a large skillet to medium-high heat. Add in 2 tbsp cooking oil. Once oil is hot, shimmers and easily moves around the skillet, add steak to the skillet in batches. Be sure not to overcrowd the skillet. Sear steak for about 1 minute to brown and then flip over to continue cooking for an additional 1 minute to brown. Remove from the skillet and repeat until all of the steak is cooked. 5. Once done cooking the steak, reduce heat to medium, add in more oil if necessary, then toss in chopped onion and chopped bell peppers. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and saute for a couple of minutes until onions and peppers are slightly softened. 6. Next, pour the sauce into the skillet, stir and simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. Then, toss the steak into the skillet and mix well until all ingredients are combined and the steak is reheated. Serve and enjoy.

If you need an easy dinner idea tonight, make these sheet pan chicken fajitas.  One of the easiest dinners ever, so flavorful, so delicious, and dinner is on the table in about 30 minutes. Everyone loved it. Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. Meanwhile, prepare the guacamole. Mash the avocados and mix with the onion, Serrano chili, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Give the chicken and vegetables a quick toss, then broil for another 2–3 minutes until slightly charred. Artist Casey Curran creates kinetic sculptures that combine mechanical systems with forms inspired by plants and natural structures. In this prototype, layers of delicate petals are connected so that a single mechanical action produces a rippling movement across the entire structure. Instead of every element moving independently, the motion travels through the sculpture like a wave. This type of movement is central to Curran’s practice. Using motors, wires, cranks and carefully engineered mechanisms, he creates artificial flowers and organisms that bloom, flutter and contract.  The machinery is artificial, but the movement feels strangely organic ,engineering becomes a way of imitating the rhythms of living systems. #art #artist #fashion #avantgarde #design

Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Season chicken evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika and place on top of cheese and butter. Top with remaining cheese and cover dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top is golden brown, liquid has been absorbed into the rice, and chicken is cooked through, about 20 more minutes. Before cooking chicken take out the fridge to allow it to get to room temperature. In a pan add oil and brown chicken on both sides then remove chicken.  Add your onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes before adding garlic.  Add your sofrito, tomatoes sauce, seasonings and olive mixtung together. Allow to simmer until fragrant.  Add your chicken back to the pot with water enough to cover the chicken. Add the potatoes and your bay leaves and let cook for 20 minutes until your potatoes are fork tender. All’università non aveva mai usato lo zaino: solo una cinghia per i libri. 🎒 Quando torna a studiare per il master tira fuori le sue vecchie cinghie. Cherry blossoms are among the most beautiful and admired flowers in the world. Known for their soft pink and white petals, these delicate blooms appear during the spring season and symbolize renewal, hope, beauty, and the short but meaningful nature of life. Cherry blossom trees, often called sakura in Japan, have become deeply connected to culture, art, poetry, and traditions across many countries. Every year, millions of people gather in parks, gardens, and streets to witness the brief but breathtaking blooming season that transforms landscapes into seas of pink and white. Cherry blossoms bloom for only a short period, usually lasting one to two weeks depending on weather conditions. This short life span is one reason they are so admired. Their beauty reminds people that life itself is temporary and precious. In Japanese culture, cherry blossoms represent the idea of living in the moment and appreciating beauty while it lasts. Festivals called hanami, meaning “flower viewing,” are held during the blooming season. Families and friends gather beneath the trees for picnics, music, laughter, and celebration while enjoying the falling petals drifting through the air like soft pink snow. The history of cherry blossoms dates back thousands of years. In ancient Japan, emperors and nobles admired the blossoms and wrote poetry inspired by them. Over time, the tradition spread throughout society and eventually became known around the world. Today, cherry blossom festivals are celebrated in many countries including the United States, South Korea, and China. One of the most famous celebrations outside Japan takes place in Washington, D.C., where thousands of cherry blossom trees bloom around the Tidal Basin each spring. These trees were gifted by Japan in 1912 as a symbol of friendship between nations.#fyp #fyp #fypシ゚viral #foryou #japan

Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. UN APAGÓN MASIVO DEJA A OSCURAS BUENA PARTE DE CASABLANCA: INVESTIGAN UN POSIBLE CIBERATAQUE Un importante apagón ha afectado este miércoles, 11 de noviembre, a numerosos barrios de Casablanca, la capital económica de Marruecos, dejando sin suministro eléctrico a viviendas, comercios y diferentes instalaciones de la ciudad. La interrupción también ha provocado problemas de tráfico, fallos en semáforos y dificultades en las comunicaciones. El corte comenzó alrededor de las 16:48 horas y afectó a zonas como Maârif, Sidi Belyout, Bourgogne, Californie, Aïn Chock, Hay Hassani y el centro de Casablanca. También se registraron interrupciones en localidades próximas, entre ellas Bouskoura y Dar Bouazza. Las imágenes difundidas desde la ciudad muestran amplias zonas sin iluminación mientras los servicios técnicos trabajan para recuperar la normalidad. En las primeras horas circularon especulaciones sobre un posible ciberataque contra la infraestructura eléctrica marroquí. Sin embargo, la compañía regional de servicios Casablanca-Settat ha explicado que el incidente se produjo en líneas de muy alta tensión pertenecientes a la red nacional de transporte eléctrico. Según la información comunicada por la empresa, la avería estuvo relacionada con las fuertes rachas de viento y las tormentas que afectaron a la región. El problema interrumpió la alimentación de varias subestaciones que suministran electricidad a distintos sectores de la metrópoli. La falta de corriente dejó semáforos fuera de servicio, provocó dificultades de circulación y obligó a algunos establecimientos a interrumpir su actividad. Los equipos de Casablanca-Settat y de la Oficina Nacional de Electricidad y Agua Potable (ONEE) iniciaron las reparaciones para restablecer el suministro. A lo largo de la tarde y la noche, varios barrios comenzaron a recuperar la electricidad. Fuente: Hespress / Medi1news #CostaDelTerror #Casablanca #Marruecos #Apagon #Ciberseguridad

Notice the GarlicDalek T did you? 😏😂 Follow the link in my bio for the link 💪❤️ HIGH PROTEIN HONEY GARLIC BUTTER CHICKEN MAC & CHEESE 9.5/10 — bloody lovely. 😂 Creamy, cheesy mac & cheese with sticky honey garlic chicken. Absolute filth, but somehow still 59g of protein per serving. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder and smoked paprika. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat with the olive oil and some of the butter. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden, flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through. 3. Lower the heat and add the remaining butter, minced garlic and honey. Give it a mixy mixy motherfucker! until the chicken is coated in that sticky honey garlic goodness. Remove and set aside. 4. Cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions. 5. In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the leftover buttery goodness for around 2 minutes. 6. Add the skimmed milk, light cream cheese, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. Serve the mac & cheese topped with the sticky honey garlic chicken and finish with fresh parsley. MACROS PER SERVING: 597 Calories | 59g Protein | 52g Carbs | 16g Fat SERVINGS: 4 Cheers: @jalalsamfit

An aquarium’s filter does far more than keep the water looking clean. It continuously removes waste, circulates oxygen, and provides a home for beneficial bacteria that break down harmful toxins produced by fish and uneaten food. Without proper filtration, ammonia and other toxic compounds can quickly build up, turning a healthy aquarium into a dangerous environment for its inhabitants. A good filtration system helps maintain water quality, stabilize the ecosystem, and keep fish healthy over the long term. While decorations and lighting may catch the eye, the filter is the unseen engine that keeps the entire aquarium alive.

Sticky Chicken & Garlic Noodles  This is an  easy weeknight dinner you can make with spaghetti or ramen noodles. I got this from my friend @mamasdownsouthkitchen 😊 Ingredients Chicken and vegetables: 1½ lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, diced 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ½ tsp black pepper 1 tbsp chili crunch (optional)  1 tsp sesame oil  2 tbsp oil (for cooking)  2 bell peppers, diced 1 onion, diced Sticky garlic sauce: ½ cup soy sauce (used reduced if you are sensitive to salt)  2 tbsp minced garlic ¼ cup honey 3 tbsp hoisin sauce 2 tbsp cornstarch Noodles: 12 oz spaghetti or 4–5 packs of ramen noodles, seasoning packets discarded Up to 1 cup reserved noodle cooking water Instructions 1. Toss the diced chicken with the garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, sesame oil, and chili crunch. Set a pot of water on the stove to boil. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the seasoned chicken and let it sear. 3. While the chicken sears, whisk together the soy sauce, honey, hoisin sauce, minced garlic, and cornstarch until smooth. 4. Add the diced bell peppers and onion to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to soften and the chicken is cooked through. 5. Cook the noodles according to the package directions. Reserve some of the cooking water before draining. 6. Stir the minced garlic into the skillet and cook for about 1 minute, until fragrant. Give the sauce another whisk, pour it into the skillet, and stir until it bubbles and thickens. Add the reserved noodle water a splash at a time until the sauce reaches your desired consistency. 7. Add the drained noodles to the skillet and toss until everything is coated in the sticky garlic sauce. Serve warm and enjoy! #easyrecipe #easydinner #dinnerideas #onepotmeals #chickenrecipe

AI video editor in Claude Code: 3 prompts, from an empty folder to a finished reel. SETUP (once) 1. Get the Claude app (claude.ai/download) and open the Code tab, not the browser. 2. Make a folder "AI Editor" with 3 folders inside: raw, references, done. 3. New chat in Code → Local → Select folder → AI Editor. Needs a paid Claude plan. PROMPT 1: TOOLS You're my video editor. We work in this folder: raw, references, done. Install and verify 5 tools: FFmpeg with libass (on Mac: ffmpeg-full, full path), faster-whisper for word-level subtitles, yt-dlp for references, Remotion, HyperFrames (npm package hyperframes). Check what's installed first. Official installs only (Homebrew, winget, npm/pip), Node.js 22+. Python packages go in a .venv here, Python 3.14 or older: pip install faster-whisper "av<19". Test each for real: burn a subtitle into a test clip, transcribe 5 seconds of audio. Show a table: tool, version, works or not. PROMPT 2: YOUR TASTE Here are reels whose editing I like: [link 1] [link 2] [link 3]. My format: [talking to camera / voiceover]. Download them with yt-dlp into references (for study only). Study each one frame by frame and by ear: pacing, shot length, pause cuts, subtitles, colors, graphics, transitions, music, the first 3 seconds. Take inspiration, but don't copy: no shots, text, logos or brand elements. Write my own style to style.md with exact values. Show it and ask what to change. PROMPT 3: EDIT My new recording is in raw. Edit it using style.md: 1. Transcribe with Whisper, word timestamps. Ask me about doubtful words before burning subtitles. 2. Cut pauses, slips and bad takes, keep the last good take. Check cut points by audio level. Keep pauses that serve the meaning, breaths and word endings. Don't speed up my voice. 3. Word-by-word subtitles in my style. 4. If references/music.mp3 exists, put it quietly under the voice. 5. Graphics only where they help. 6. Export 1080×1920 to done as draft-v1.mp4 plus edit-notes.md. Check the file yourself, then show me. I'll give edits in plain words; save each as draft-v2, draft-v3. No code words. Follow for my own editing style, coming next.

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Save 1/2 cup oil for the Hot Oil 5.  Whisk the reserved hot oil with cayenne, brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, and salt. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 6.  Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11.  Slice and serve Enjoy! #easyrecipesathome #garlicbread #nashvillehotchicken #cooking #viralrecipes

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

videos.caption: cajun chicken pasta 😮‍💨 Another delicious idea for your next pasta night! Creamy, a little spicy, and packed with cajun flavor 🌶️ Ingredients (2 servings): Chicken breast ~ 300 g (10.5 oz) Pasta ~ 200 g (7 oz) Onion – 1/2 pc Garlic – 1–2 cloves Fresh tomato – 1/2 medium, diced Heavy cream – 200 ml (3/4 cup + 1 tbsp) Parmesan – 40 g (1.5 oz) Avocado oil / olive oil – 1 tbsp Butter – 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning (paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper, oregano, thyme) – 2 tbsp, to taste Salt – to taste Pasta water – as needed Fresh parsley – for serving Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breast horizontally into two thinner steaks. Season both sides generously with cajun seasoning and salt. 2. Heat avocado oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for a few minutes on each side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from the pan and set aside. 3. In the same pan, melt the butter. Add the diced onion and cook until softened. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Then add the diced fresh tomato and cook for another 2 minutes. 4. Pour in the heavy cream, add a little more cajun seasoning, and stir until combined. Add the grated parmesan and let the sauce simmer gently until creamy. 5. Meanwhile, cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve some pasta water before draining. 6. Add the cooked pasta to the sauce and toss until well coated. Add a splash of pasta water if needed to get that silky consistency. 7. Slice the chicken into strips, place on top of the pasta, and finish with freshly grated parmesan and chopped fresh parsley. Enjoyy! #easyrecipe #pasta #quickdinner #chickenrecipe

Recipe Name Honey Garlic Chicken with Creamy Parmesan Penne Ingredients 1. 2 large chicken breasts, sliced 2. 12 oz (340 g) penne pasta 3. 2 tbsp olive oil 4. 2 tbsp butter 5. 4 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 8. 1 tsp salt 9. 1/2 tsp black pepper 10. 1 cup heavy cream 11. 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1/2 cup chicken broth 13. 1 tbsp honey 14. 1 tbsp soy sauce 15. 1 tsp Dijon mustard 16. 1 tbsp chopped parsley Recipe 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne until al dente. Drain and set aside. 2. Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. 3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and slice. 4. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Stir in the honey, soy sauce, Dijon mustard, and chicken broth. Simmer for 2 minutes. 6. Add the heavy cream and cook over medium heat until slightly thickened. 7. Stir in the Parmesan cheese until smooth and creamy. 8. Toss the cooked penne into the sauce, coating every piece evenly. 9. Return the sliced chicken to the skillet and spoon some sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 2 minutes to blend the flavors. 11. Garnish with chopped parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. 12. Serve hot with garlic bread or a fresh salad. Follow for more delicious and easy recipes!

Cozy Dinner Idea 🤎 Creamy Chicken Marsala 🍄 INGREDIENTS For the Chicken: • 2 large chicken breasts, sliced horizontally into 4 cutlets • Kinder’s Grilled Chicken Seasoning • Salt, to taste • ½ cup all-purpose flour • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp unsalted butter For the Marsala Sauce: • 8 oz baby bella mushrooms, sliced • 1 shallot, finely diced • 3–4 garlic cloves, minced • ¾ cup Marsala cooking wine • ¾ cup chicken broth • ½ cup heavy cream • 3–4 sprigs fresh thyme • Salt & black pepper, to taste • 1 tbsp butter (optional, for finishing) • Fresh parsley, for garnish INSTRUCTIONS 1. Season chicken cutlets on both sides with salt and Kinder’s Grilled Chicken Seasoning. Lightly coat each piece in flour, shaking off any excess. 2. Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden brown. Remove and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add sliced mushrooms to the remaining butter, oil, and chicken drippings. Sauté for 5–7 minutes until golden brown. 4. Add diced shallots and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in minced garlic and fresh thyme, cooking for another 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in Marsala cooking wine, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. Simmer for 3–5 minutes until reduced by half. 6. Add chicken broth and simmer for another 3–4 minutes. Reduce heat to medium-low, stir in heavy cream, and let the sauce gently simmer until slightly thickened. 7. Return chicken and any juices to the skillet. Spoon the creamy mushroom sauce over the chicken and simmer for 3–5 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally. 8. Remove thyme stems, stir in a tablespoon of butter if desired for a silky finish, and garnish with fresh parsley. #ChickenMarsala #DinnerIdeas #EasyDinnerRecipes #QuickDinner #CozyDinner

💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers!!!  Tender chicken coated in a honey garlic soy sauce with sautéed peppers. Sticky, savory, and perfect over rice!!!  Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers  2 large chicken breast  Neutral oil  1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp soy 1/2 tsp onion powder  1 tsp cornstarch  Sauce  Bell peppers, sliced (for sautéing) 1 tsp ginger paste or grated  2 tbsp garlic paste  2 tbsp honey  1/4 cup light and dark soy combined  1 tsp rice seasoning  1 tbsp hoisin sauce  1/2 tbsp oyster sauce  1/2 tsp Totole Granulated Chicken Flavor Season the chicken with neutral oil, seasonings, and cornstarch. Marinate for at least 2 hours. Cook the chicken in a skillet 2–3 minutes per side until lightly browned, then remove and set aside. In the same pan, sauté the sliced peppers until they reach your desired texture, then add the garlic paste. Pour in the sauce and simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally. If needed, add a 1:1 cornstarch slurry to thicken. Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together until coated. Garnish with sliced green onions and enjoy #Foodie #cooking #food #honeygarlicchicken #chicken

Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍯🧀🍟 By far one of the best combos i’ve made, all made around making meal prepping easy and effortless. The chicken is absolutely INCREDIBLE! Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. Serve and ENJOY! . . #garlicparmesan #healthyrecipes #mealprep #sheetpandinner #batchcooking

My sister-in-law’s famous Thanksgiving mashed potatoes 🥔 I’m also releasing a completely free Thanksgiving cookbook with recipes for every staple Thanksgiving dish you need for the big day. Everything is easy and doable without sacrificing flavor. Coming very soon, so follow my page so you don’t miss it Ingredients • 5 lb Yukon gold potatoes • 16 oz cream cheese, softened • ⅓ cup sour cream • ½ cup milk • 1 stick butter, softened, plus extra slices for topping • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp salt • Paprika, for topping • 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped Instructions 1. Set out the cream cheese and butter to soften. Preheat the oven to 400°F. 2. Boiling Method: Peel the potatoes and cut into evenly sized chunks. Place in a large pot, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 15–20 minutes, or until fork-tender. 3. Instant Pot Method (Alternative): Add 1 cup of water to the Instant Pot and place the trivet inside. Add the whole, unpeeled potatoes. Pressure cook on high for 14 minutes, then allow a 10-minute natural pressure release before releasing the remaining pressure. Carefully remove, cool slightly, and peel. Cook in batches if necessary. 4. Transfer cooked potatoes to a large mixing bowl. Add cream cheese, sour cream, milk, butter, salt, and pepper. 5. Use a hand mixer or stand mixer to mix until smooth and creamy, being careful not to overmix. 6. Transfer to a greased 9×13-inch baking dish and spread evenly. 7. Sprinkle paprika over the top and add a few thin slices of butter. 8. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. 9. Bake at 400°F for 60 minutes, or until heated through. 10. Remove the foil during the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 11. Sprinkle the freshly chopped chives over the top before serving. Make-Ahead Instructions 1. Prepare the mashed potatoes following steps 1–8 above, using either cooking method. Wait to preheat the oven until you’re ready to bake. 2. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate for up to 2 days. 3. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. 4. Preheat oven to 400°F. 5. Bake covered for approximately 60 minutes, until hot in the center. 6. Remove foil for the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 7. Sprinkle with the chopped chives before serving. #mashedpotatoes #EasyRecipe

Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Season chicken with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. 3. Sear chicken in olive oil until golden on both sides. 4. Transfer chicken to a baking dish. 5. Melt butter in the skillet and sauté mushrooms until browned. 6. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. 7. Stir in chicken broth and heavy cream. 8. Simmer for 3 minutes. 9. Add spinach and cook until wilted. 10. Pour sauce over chicken. 11. Top with mozzarella and Parmesan. 12. Bake 20–25 minutes until bubbly. 13. Broil 2 minutes for a golden top. 14. Easy High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍯🍗🧀 59g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros Per Serve, Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Like recipes like this? Check out my cookbooks! LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! Store in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 to 4 days, or freeze individual portions for longer storage. #macandcheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes #chickenmacandcheese

Let your crockpot do all the hard work while your kitchen fills with the most incredible aroma. 🔥 INGREDIENTS: 🥩 2–2.5 lbs beef stew meat 🧈 5 tbsp butter 🧄 6–8 cloves minced garlic 🥣 1 cup beef broth 🥄 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 🥄 1 tsp Dijon mustard 🧂 1 tsp Italian seasoning 🧂 1 tsp paprika 🧂 Salt, pepper & onion powder 🥛 1 cup heavy whipping cream 🧀 ¾ cup freshly grated Parmesan 🥄 1 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp cold water 👨‍🍳 DIRECTIONS: 1. Season beef with salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, paprika, and onion powder. 2. Sear beef in olive oil until browned on all sides. 3. Melt butter in the same skillet. Add garlic and cook for 30–60 seconds. 4. Stir in beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, and Dijon mustard. 5. Transfer beef and sauce to your crockpot. 6. Cook on LOW for 6–8 hours or HIGH for 3–4 hours until fork-tender. 7. During the last 20–30 minutes, stir in heavy cream, Parmesan, and cornstarch slurry. 8. Let the sauce thicken and finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan! 🍽️ BEST SERVED OVER: Creamy mashed potatoes, rice, or buttery egg noodles! ❤️ SAVE THIS RECIPE for your next dinner night! 👇 Would you serve these over mashed potatoes or egg noodles? we love a crockpot meal around here 🙋🏼‍♀️ can’t go wrong with Marry Me Chicken Orzo (full recipe below!)🫶🏼 Ingredients -1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts -¾ cup sun-dried tomatoes, mostly drained and chopped -4 cloves garlic, minced -1 small yellow onion, finely diced -2½–3 cups low-sodium chicken bone broth, divided -1 tsp Italian seasoning -½ tsp paprika -1 tsp salt, plus more to taste -1 tsp black pepper -red pepper flakes (to taste, optional) -1½ cups dry orzo -3/4 cup half & half (can use more or less depending on how creamy you like it!) -½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese -2 cups baby spinach -Fresh basil, for serving Instructions Add chicken breasts, sun-dried tomatoes (I also like to add in a little splash of the oil they’re in too for some extra flavor), garlic, onion, 1½ cups chicken bone broth, Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes to the crockpot. Stir to combine. Cover and cook on low for 3–4 hours or high for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked. Remove the chicken from the crockpot and shred using a hand mixer or two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the crockpot and stir into the sauce. Stir in 1½ cups dry orzo and 1 additional cup chicken bone broth. Make sure the orzo is mostly submerged in liquid! Cover and cook on high for 20–35 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes, until the orzo is tender. Add up to ½ cup additional broth as needed to prevent sticking or drying out. Once the orzo is fully cooked, turn the crockpot to warm. Stir in half & half and freshly grated parmesan until melted and creamy. Then fold in spinach (I’ll recover for another few minutes to let the spinach get soft) Top with fresh basil, extra parmesan, red pepper flakes, etc & enjoy! #cookwithme #crockpotrecipes #easyrecipes #dinnerideas #crockpotdinnerideas

Tender pan-seared chicken, creamy garlic parmesan gravy, and buttery mashed potatoes that soak up every last drop. ✨ 🕒 Total Time: ~45 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. 🌈 SUPER SIMPLE TASTE-SAFE KINETIC SAND 🌈 If you’re looking for kid safe kinetic sand - this is it! It might not have the silicone binder that store bought has which gives a stretchy effect, but it’s made with 5 simple ingredients, that still gives it the ability to be squished and moulded while holding its shape and it crumbles like sand. It’s fun, cheap, and so easy to whip up… plus your little ones will love it! INGREDIENTS: 1 cup baking soda 1/2 cup sugar 3/4 cup cornflour  1 Tbsp cream of tartar 1/4 cup of water 1 tsp food colouring (optional) HOW TO: 1. Add the baking soda, sugar, cornflour, and cream of tartar to a large bowl, and stir  everything together. 2. In a small cup, mix your food colouring & water (if you’re using food colouring). 3. Add 2 Tbsp of the water into the dry mix and whisk together. If its still too powdery and doesn’t clump in your hands, add 1 Tbsp more of the water, and stir again. Repeat up to the full 1/4 cup of water, squishing with your hands to mix it in and get the right texture (note if you get heavy handed with the water, counterbalance it by adding equal parts cornflour & sugar, 1 Tbsp of each at a time) 4. Enjoy! NOTES: 🫙 Store in an airtight container in the fridge for 4–6 weeks. If it dries out a little, add 1–2 tsp of water and mix it through with your hands. 🌈  you can make the colour brighter by adding a few extra drops into the water at the beginning. 👶 whilst this recipe is taste-safe, make sure to supervise little ones closely as it’s not for eating by the handful.  . . . . . #kineticsand #toddler #kidsactivities #sensoryplay #playtolearn

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

Link in bio 🔗 or Jackedcookbook.com 📘👀 Ingredients: -2 lbs Chicken Breast (907g) -2 lbs Sweet Potatoes (907g) -4 Cups Cauliflower Florets (400g) -1 Medium Red Onion (150g), sliced -1 Tbsp Paprika -1 tsp Garlic Powder -1 tsp Onion Powder -Salt & Black Pepper, to taste -Olive Oil Cooking Spray Buffalo Honey Sauce: -1/4 Cup Buffalo Sauce (60mL) -2 Tbsp Honey (42g) For Garnish: -1/2 Cup Crumbled Feta Cheese (75g) -2 Green Onions, sliced -Extra buffalo sauce, if desired Instructions: (Link in Bio to all my Kitchen Tools) 1.) Cozy & Affordable Baked Chicken Dinner 🍗🤎 Tonight I was going for cozy, comforting, and affordable, and this is one of my go-to dinners when I want something simple but still really good. Ingredients: * Chicken legs * Olive oil * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Seasoning salt * Black pepper * Italian seasoning * 1 orange bell pepper, sliced * 1 green bell pepper, sliced * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cans cream of mushroom soup * ½–1 cup chicken broth * Jasmine rice * French-style green beans * Buttermilk biscuits * Honey for glazing Instructions: 1. Season the chicken legs with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoning salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well so the seasoning coats the chicken. 3. Slice the peppers and onion. 4. Sauté the peppers and onions in a skillet until they begin to soften. 5. Add the cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Stir until smooth and creamy. 6. Place the seasoned chicken in a baking dish and pour the creamy mixture over the top. 7. Bake at 375°F for about 50–60 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and is fully cooked. 8. Serve with jasmine rice, French-style green beans, and a warm buttermilk biscuit finished with a little honey. Affordable, filling, and the perfect comfort dinner. Sheet Pan BBQ Chicken & Braised Parmesan Cabbage 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs 2 yellow onions, sliced into ¼” rounds 3 russet potatoes, sliced into ¼” rounds Olive oil Salt and pepper BBQ sauce Slice onions and potatoes into ¼” rounds; toss with oil, salt, and pepper, then layer tightly on a sheet pan. Coat chicken in BBQ sauce and place on top. Roast at 400°F for 25–28 minutes, until cooked through. Remove chicken; broil vegetables 3–5 minutes to crisp. Return chicken, brush with more BBQ sauce, and broil 2–3 minutes until caramelized.  Braised Parmesan Cabbage 1 green cabbage, cut into 4 wedges Olive oil 2 tsp minced garlic 2 cups chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream 1½ cups freshly grated Parmesan, divided ⅓ cup minced chives Sear cabbage wedges in olive oil with salt over medium-high heat until well charred. Add garlic; sauté 1 minute. Pour in chicken broth and cream; bring to a simmer and cook 6–8 minutes, turning once. Sprinkle 1 cup Parmesan over cabbage and transfer to a 375°F oven; roast 10–15 minutes. Broil 1–2 minutes for a browned top.  Finish with remaining Parmesan and chives before serving. Crispy Chicken Thighs & Creamy Orzo 6–8 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs Salt Sear chicken skin-side down in olive oil over medium-high heat until crispy. Flip; cook 2–3 minutes more, then set aside. In the same pan, add: 3 tbsp butter 2 tbsp minced garlic 4 leeks, trimmed, halved lengthwise, thinly sliced Salt and pepper; sauté 5 minutes until softened. Stir in: 1 lb orzo (toast 2 minutes) 2 cups chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, nestle chicken on top skin-side up, and bake at 400°F for 15–20 minutes, until orzo is tender and chicken is cooked through.#mealprep #bulking #inseason #athletes #sheetpandinner @Smithey Ironware @Nordic Ware @SweetBabyRay

Cheat code meal prep. This Mexican cheesy chicken and rice might be one of my all time favorites so far. Honestly… I totally outdid myself with this one. The flavor is unreal and each meal packs over 50 grams of protein to keep you full and on track. Here is how to make it. Pico de gallo 5 roma tomatoes 1 jalapeno 1 bunch cilantro Juice of 1 lime 1 white onion Salt, pepper, garlic powder Dice everything and mix together with the lime juice and seasonings. Chicken 3 pounds chicken 2 packets taco seasoning Juice of 1 lime 1 tablespoon avocado oil Cook the chicken in a pan on medium high heat with the avocado oil. Add taco seasoning and lime juice and cook until fully done. Mexican rice 1½ cups dry rice 3 cups water 3 tablespoons tomato paste Sazón seasoning 1 sweet onion Saute the onion first. Add the rice and lightly toast it. Then add the water, tomato paste, and sazón seasoning. Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low for about 10 minutes. High protein queso 2 cups low fat cottage cheese 2 cups shredded jalapeno cheddar 2 tablespoons diced green onion Diced green chili pepper Splash of lime juice Milk to thin Blend the cottage cheese until smooth, then heat with the shredded cheese, green onion, green chili, lime juice, and a little milk until it becomes a creamy queso. Layer the chicken, rice, pico, and drizzle the high protein queso on top. Big flavor. High protein. Perfect for meal prep. 🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 40 minutes Total Time: 55 minutes Servings: 4 Calories: Approximately 610 per serving #ParmesanChicken #SheetPanDinner #EasyDinner #ComfortFood #FamilyMeals

artist and automata maker Amedeo Capelli, known as Stoccafisso Design, creates playful mechanical sculptures from wood, wire and simple mechanisms. In his recent shrimp automata, a handmade crustacean comes to life through a system of wooden gears, cams, rods and rotating parts hidden beneath the stage. Turning the crank transfers motion through the mechanism, making the shrimp’s body and limbs move in an exaggerated, almost theatrical way. Capelli’s work combines traditional automata-making, kinetic sculpture and humor. Instead of hiding the mechanics, he often leaves them visible, allowing us to understand how a simple rotation can be transformed into surprisingly complex movement. #shrimp #art #artist #niche #weird

videos.caption: One stick of butter, a handful of simple ingredients, and a whole house filled with the smell of love. 🧈✨ This is my grandmother's Stick of Butter Chicken and Rice… the kind of easy chicken and rice casserole that simmers with memory and makes you feel held before the first bite. Chicken thighs baked over rice with French onion soup, beef consommé, mushrooms, Parmesan, and a whole stick of butter. It tastes like legacy and everything good. One dish, minimal prep, and a homemade family dinner that feels like a hug. 🤍 INGREDIENTS: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-oz) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5-oz) cans condensed beef consommé 8 oz baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan, divided 1 stick salted butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Seasoning 1¼ tsp kosher salt ¾ tsp freshly ground black pepper 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp paprika To finish (optional) 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley DIRECTIONS: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. 2. In a 9×13 baking dish, stir together the rice, French onion soup, beef consommé, and chopped mushrooms. Spread everything into an even layer. 3. Sprinkle ¾ cup of the cheese over the rice mixture, then dot the top with the pieces of butter. 4. Season the chicken thighs evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. Arrange the chicken on top of the rice mixture. 5. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the chicken, then cover the dish tightly with foil. 6. Bake for 45 minutes. 7. Remove the foil and continue baking for about 20 minutes, until the top is golden, the rice has absorbed the liquid, and the chicken is cooked through and tender. 8. Let it rest for a few minutes, then finish with fresh parsley if you like. #StickOfButterChickenAndRice #ChickenAndRiceCasserole #ComfortFoodRecipes #EasyDinnerIdeas #FamilyRecipe

videos.caption: Ornamental grasses do particularly well in the Northeast because many varieties are naturally adapted to cold winters, seasonal changes, and a wide range of soil conditions. Their deep, extensive root systems help them tolerate periods of summer heat and drought once established, while their dormant crowns allow them to survive freezing temperatures and return reliably each spring. Many grasses also thrive in the Northeast’s full sun and well-drained soils and require relatively little maintenance compared with many flowering plants. Their ability to handle both the cold winters and humid summers makes them a dependable choice for Northeast landscapes, while their movement, texture, and winter interest add structure to the landscape year-round.#Westchester#westchestercounty #planting #landscapedesign #Greenwich
